effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Attacking] ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
[Your Turn] This Digimon can only digivolve into white Digimon.
[End of Opponent's Turn] Delete this Digimon. Then, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Dark Masters] trait, other than [Machinedramon], from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
